qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the 91°C temperature switch?
What torque should be applied to the 99°C temperature switch?
What is the torque specification for oil pressure switches on M10/M40/M42/M21/M51/M20/M30/M50/M60/1/M60/2/M70/S70 engines?
What torque should be used for oil pressure switches on S14/S50/S38/M43 engines?
How much torque is specified for the reversing light switch?
What torque should be applied to the transmission switch on shift block?
Do the 91°C and 99°C temperature switches have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the 91°C and 99°C temperature switches have the same torque specification of 14 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Which switch has the lowest torque specification in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: The light switch on instrument panel for E36/E38 models has the lowest torque specification at 2 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What special note is mentioned for the oil pressure switch installation?
qa_pairs.answer: The note states 'oil and screw in' for the oil pressure switch installation.
